about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Shakshuka with Preserved Lemon and Olives
recipes.summary: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and capsicum sauce brightened with preserved lemon and green olives.
steps: Cook the onion and capsicum in the oil for 8 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the tomatoes, preserved lemon and olives and simmer for 10 minutes, until thick.
Make 4 wells and crack in the eggs, then cover and cook for 6 minutes, until the whites are set.
Scatter with coriander and serve from the pan.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set and the yolks are as firm as you are comfortable with; cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Huevos Divorciados Divorced Eggs
recipes.summary: Two fried eggs on corn tortillas, one under red salsa and one under green, with beans between.
steps: Warm the beans in a small pan for 4 minutes, until hot.
Fry the tortillas in the oil for 30 seconds each side, until lightly crisp.
Fry the eggs in a little oil for 3 minutes, until the whites are set and the edges crisp.
Warm both salsas separately for 2 minutes, until steaming.
Top each tortilla with an egg, spoon red salsa on one side and green on the other, then add beans, feta and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Oeufs Cocotte with Spinach and Cream
recipes.summary: Eggs baked in ramekins over creamed spinach until the whites are just set.
steps: Wilt the spinach with the butter and garlic in a pan for 2 minutes, until soft, then squeeze out any liquid and chop.
Stir in half the cream, nutmeg and salt.
Divide among four buttered ramekins and crack an egg into each.
Spoon over the remaining cream and bake at 180C for 12 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks wobble slightly.
Serve with toast soldiers while the eggs are still warm and just set.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; bake a few minutes longer for firm yolks if serving anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Persian Nargesi Spinach and Egg Pan
recipes.summary: Spinach cooked with garlic and turmeric, topped with eggs that set into the greens.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft and golden.
Add the garlic and turmeric for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the spinach in batches and cook for 5 minutes, until wilted, then stir in the salt and lemon juice.
Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes, until the whites are set.
Serve with warm flatbread.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Indian Egg Bhurji Masala Scramble
recipes.summary: Spiced scrambled eggs with onion, tomato and green chilli, the Mumbai street breakfast.
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion and chilli for 4 minutes, until soft.
Add the tomato, turmeric and cumin and cook for 3 minutes, until pulpy.
Beat the eggs with the salt, pour in and stir gently for 2 minutes, until just set.
Scatter with coriander and check the eggs are fully set with no liquid left.
Serve with buttered toast until the plates are clean, while hot.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set with no liquid egg remaining; serve straight away.

recipes.title: Korean Gyeran Mari Rolled Omelette
recipes.summary: A neat rolled omelette with carrot and spring onion, cut in rounds as a banchan or lunchbox side.
steps: Beat the eggs with the salt, spring onion and carrot.
Heat a thin film of oil in a small non-stick pan over low heat.
Pour in a thin layer and cook for 1 minute, until just set but still glossy, then roll to one end.
Oil the pan again, pour in more egg, lift the roll to let it flow under and cook until set, then roll again.
Repeat until the egg is used, rest for 2 minutes and slice.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until fully set with no liquid egg remaining. Keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Khai Palo Thai Five Spice Egg Stew
recipes.summary: Boiled eggs braised in a sweet, five-spice soy broth until deeply brown, served with rice.
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes until the yolks are firm, then cool in cold water and peel.
Simmer the water, soy sauce, sugar, cinnamon, star anise, garlic and pepper for 10 minutes, until slightly syrupy.
Add the eggs and simmer for 10 minutes, turning, until deeply brown and glossy.
Serve with coriander and steamed rice.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs for 10 minutes until the yolks are firm. Keeps 3 days in the fridge in the braising liquid.

recipes.title: Greek Strapatsada Tomato and Feta Scramble
recipes.summary: Soft eggs folded into stewed tomato and feta, a classic island breakfast.
steps: Cook the garlic in the oil for 30 seconds, until fragrant, then add the tomato.
Simmer for 8 minutes, until thick and jammy.
Beat the eggs and pour in, stirring gently for 2 minutes, until just set.
Crumble in the feta and oregano.
Serve straight away with thick toast, while the eggs are still hot.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set with no liquid egg remaining.

recipes.title: Uova in Purgatorio Eggs in Spicy Tomato
recipes.summary: Eggs poached in fiery tomato and garlic sauce, mopped up with crusty bread.
steps: Cook the garlic and chilli in the oil for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, oregano and salt and simmer for 12 minutes, until thick.
Make 4 wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes, until the whites are set.
Scatter with basil and serve with bread.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Hungarian Lecso with Eggs
recipes.summary: Sweet capsicum, tomato and onion stewed with paprika, with eggs stirred in for a rustic one-pan meal.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 8 minutes, until soft.
Add the capsicum and paprika and cook for 8 minutes more, until soft.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 6 minutes, until saucy.
Crack the eggs in, cover and cook for 4 minutes, until the whites are set.
Serve straight from the pan with warm rye bread.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Chimichurri Rojo Red Chimichurri
recipes.summary: A red capsicum and paprika chimichurri, smoky and herby for grilled vegetables and steak.

items: 1 roasted red capsicum from a jar, chopped

steps: Chop the parsley and garlic finely.
Mix with the capsicum, oil, vinegar, paprika, oregano, chilli and salt.
Stand for 20 minutes so the flavours develop.
Taste and add more vinegar or salt if needed.
Spoon over grilled meat or vegetables until generously coated.
notes: Keeps 5 days in the fridge in a clean jar.

recipes.title: Imli Tamarind and Date Chutney
recipes.summary: Sweet-sour tamarind and date chutney with ginger and cumin, the chaat table's essential drizzle.
steps: Simmer the tamarind, dates and water for 15 minutes, until very soft.
Blend until smooth and sieve to remove fibres.
Return to the pan with the sugar, spices and salt and simmer for 5 minutes, until thick and glossy.
Cool completely before serving or storing in a jar.
notes: Keeps 2 weeks in the fridge in a clean jar and freezes well.

recipes.title: Sweet Mango Chutney
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked green mango chutney with ginger, chilli and vinegar to serve with curries and cheese.

items: 3 firm green mangoes, peeled and diced

steps: Simmer the vinegar and sugar for 5 minutes until the sugar dissolves.
Add the mango, onion, ginger, chilli, cinnamon, sultanas and salt.
Cook for 35 minutes, stirring often, until thick and jammy.
Cool for 10 minutes, remove the cinnamon and pack into sterilised jars.
Seal the jars and refrigerate once cooled.
notes: Keeps 1 month in the fridge in sterilised jars; discard if mouldy.

recipes.title: Raita Crunch Yoghurt with Crunchy Chickpeas
recipes.summary: Cool spiced yoghurt with crunchy roasted chickpeas, served with biryani and kebabs.
steps: Whisk the yoghurt, water, cumin, chilli and salt until smooth.
Stir in the chopped mint and taste for salt.
Fold in the chickpeas just before serving so they stay crisp.
Taste and adjust the salt.
Serve chilled in a bowl alongside rice.
notes: Contains dairy. Make just before serving, as the chickpeas soften quickly.

recipes.title: Syrian Muhammara Walnut and Capsicum Dip
recipes.summary: A smoky dip of roasted capsicum and walnuts with pomegranate molasses and chilli.

items: 2 roasted red capsicums from a jar

steps: Blend the capsicum, walnuts, breadcrumbs, molasses, garlic, cumin and chilli until almost smooth.
With the blender running, add the oil in a slow stream.
Season with the salt and blend briefly.
Taste and add more molasses or chilli if needed.
Serve with warm flatbread or vegetable sticks.
notes: Contains tree nuts and gluten. Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Green Zhug Herb and Chilli Sauce
recipes.summary: A blistering green sauce of coriander, parsley, chilli and cardamom, spooned over falafel and eggs.
steps: Blend the herbs, chillies, garlic and spices to a rough paste.
Blend in the oil and lemon juice until combined.
Season with the salt and blend briefly.
Taste and add more lemon if needed.
Spoon into a clean jar and press down.
notes: Keeps 1 week in the fridge with a film of oil on top.

recipes.title: Harissa Paste
recipes.summary: A deep red Tunisian chilli paste with roasted capsicum, caraway and garlic to stir into stews and marinades.

items: 10 dried red chillies, soaked and drained
2 roasted red capsicums from a jar

steps: Toast the caraway, cumin and coriander in a dry pan for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Blend the chillies, capsicum, garlic and spices to a thick paste.
Blend in the lemon juice, salt and 2 tablespoons of oil.
Spoon into a jar and cover with the remaining oil.
Refrigerate the jar with the oil on top.
notes: Wear gloves for the chillies. Keeps 1 month in the fridge under a film of oil.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chermoula Herb Marinade
recipes.summary: A garlicky coriander, parsley and cumin sauce, spooned over roast vegetables and grilled fish.
steps: Blend the coriander, parsley and garlic to a coarse paste.
Blend in the spices, oil and lemon juice until combined.
Season with the salt and blend briefly.
Taste and adjust the lemon.
Store in a clean jar with a film of oil.
notes: Keeps 5 days in the fridge. Use for marinating only before cooking; do not reuse marinade that touched raw meat or fish.

recipes.title: Sambal Matah Balinese Raw Shallot Sambal
recipes.summary: A fresh raw sambal of sliced shallot, chilli and lemongrass, dressed with hot oil and lime.

items: 2 lemongrass stalks, white part finely sliced

steps: Mix the shallot, chilli, lemongrass and lime leaves in a bowl.
Heat the coconut oil until shimmering and pour over the mixture so it sizzles.
Stir in the lime juice and salt.
Taste and adjust the lime and salt.
Serve within an hour with grilled fish or rice.
notes: Serve the same day. Handle hot oil carefully.

recipes.title: Thai Nam Jim Jaew Roasted Chilli Dipping Sauce
recipes.summary: Smoky, tangy dipping sauce with toasted rice powder, lime and fish sauce for grilled meats and vegetables.
steps: Toast the rice in a dry pan for 4 minutes, until deep golden, then crush to a coarse powder.
Stir the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar and chilli flakes until the sugar dissolves.
Add the rice powder, shallots and herbs.
Taste and balance with more lime or sugar.
Serve in small bowls beside grilled food.
notes: Best on the day it is made. Contains fish sauce.

recipes.title: Japanese Ponzu Citrus Soy Sauce
recipes.summary: A tangy citrus soy sauce for dumplings, grilled fish and cold noodles.
steps: Combine the soy sauce, lemon juice, lime juice, mirin, vinegar, sugar and kombu in a jar.
Shake until the sugar dissolves.
Rest in the fridge overnight.
Remove the kombu and discard it.
Serve in small dishes for dipping.
notes: Resting time is not included in prep. Keeps 1 month in the fridge.

recipes.title: Mushroom XO Style Umami Sauce
recipes.summary: A savoury, chilli-spiked mushroom and garlic condiment with a deep umami taste, great on noodles and rice.
steps: Fry the mushrooms in the oil over medium heat for 10 minutes, until deep golden and dry.
Add the shallot, garlic, chilli and ginger and cook for 5 minutes, until fragrant and golden.
Stir in the soy sauce, oyster sauce and sugar and cook for 4 minutes, until glossy.
Cool and pack into a clean jar.
Refrigerate with the oil on top.
notes: Contains oyster sauce. Keeps 3 weeks in the fridge under the oil.
